import hashlib, json, os, shutil, stat, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
JAR = Path('/home/ec2-user/app.jar')
BACKUP = Path('/var/backups/f2r-pr914-df425588')
EXPECTED = '18ca78cb7743fbd9e94e055fa5c6a4cd6fb5ca1011885b63d866f96eaa1dcdc0'
ENV_FILES = [Path('/etc/f2r/env'), Path('/etc/buildit-wiki-identity.env')]
import hashlib
import shutil
import zipfile
import fcntl
import re
RECEIPT = BACKUP / 'deployment.json'
BUCKET = 'f2r-deploy-425805163960'
PREFIX = 'pr914-approved/'
STAGING_ROOT = '/var/tmp'
APPROVED_FILES = {'BOOT-INF/classes/static/css/f2r_home_compact.css': '508f5b9d14e87ff14e2690cd871b246f53de7e7dbaecd811f008bbffadf823e8', 'BOOT-INF/classes/static/js/f2r_home_presentation.js': '12325ee126d1f271ca2624652bf2dbbd9d5513c180a9e688292d058a8579c5d2', 'BOOT-INF/classes/templates/public/landing.html': '9cc5055caf3a8f920df6fca98df70c1c5712eb2059d9c483f7cbffc3e5314168'}
def atomic_restore(source,target,metadata):
    fd,name=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.f2r914-restore-',dir=target.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f, open(source,'rb') as src:
            shutil.copyfileobj(src,f);f.flush();os.fchown(f.fileno(),metadata['uid'],metadata['gid']);os.fchmod(f.fileno(),metadata['mode']);os.fsync(f.fileno())
        require(digest(Path(name))==digest(source),'restore staging hash mismatch')
        os.replace(name,target)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(name):os.unlink(name)

def check_backup():
    private_directory()
    p=BACKUP/'manifest.json'
    require(p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), 'complete backup manifest absent')
    data=json.loads(p.read_text())
    require(data['baseline_sha256']==EXPECTED, 'wrong backup baseline')
    require(digest(BACKUP/'app.jar')['sha256']==EXPECTED, 'backup JAR hash mismatch')
    for name,record in data['media']['files'].items():
        rel=Path(name)
        require(not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts and rel.parts[0] in ('seven','suni'), 'invalid backup media path')
        require(digest(BACKUP/'media'/rel)==record, 'backup media hash mismatch')
    for item in data['env']:
        require(item['path'] in [str(p) for p in ENV_FILES], 'invalid env path')
        if item['exists']: require(digest(BACKUP/'env'/Path(item['path']).name)==item['digest'], 'backup environment hash mismatch')
    return data

def command(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()

def digest(p):
    require(not p.is_symlink(), 'symlink rejected')
    with os.fdopen(os.open(p, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW), 'rb') as f:
        before = os.fstat(f.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), 'regular file required')
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''): h.update(chunk)
        after = os.fstat(f.fileno())
        require((before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==(after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns), 'source changed during hash')
    return {'sha256':h.hexdigest(), 'bytes':after.st_size}

def environment_unchanged(data):
    for item in data['env']:
        p = Path(item['path'])
        require(p.exists() == item['exists'], 'environment presence changed')
        if item['exists']:
            require(digest(p) == item['digest'], 'environment content changed')

def health():
    for _ in range(36):
        try:
            command('curl', '-fsS', '--max-time', '5', '-o', '/dev/null', 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health')
            require(command('systemctl', 'is-active', 'f2r-app.service') == 'active', 'service inactive')
            return
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, RuntimeError):
            time.sleep(5)
    raise RuntimeError('service health failed')

def media_manifest(root):
    files={}
    for agent in ('seven','suni'):
        directory=root/agent
        require(directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink(), 'both character directories must exist without symlinks')
        for p in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
            require(not p.is_symlink(), 'media symlink requires separate review')
            if p.is_file(): files[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=digest(p)
        names=[n for n in files if n.startswith(agent+'/')]
        require(any(n.endswith(('.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.webp')) for n in names), 'character image missing')
        require(any(n.endswith('.mp4') for n in names), 'character MP4 missing')
    return {'root':str(root),'files':files}

def media_unchanged(data):
    require(media_manifest(Path(data['media']['root'])) == data['media'], 'production media drift; originals not overwritten')

def private_directory():
    require(BACKUP.is_dir() and not BACKUP.is_symlink(), 'fixed backup directory absent')
    s=BACKUP.stat()
    require(s.st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)==0o700, 'backup must be root-owned mode 0700')

def ready_to_restart():
    require(os.geteuid() == 0, 'root execution required')
    require(command('systemctl', 'show', 'f2r-app.service', '-p', 'LoadState', '--value') == 'loaded', 'service unavailable')
    for key in ('RefuseManualStart', 'RefuseManualStop'):
        require(command('systemctl', 'show', 'f2r-app.service', '-p', key, '--value') == 'no', 'manual service operations refused')

def require(ok, reason):
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(reason)

def rollback():
    data = verify_restore()
    ready_to_restart()
    current = digest(JAR)['sha256']
    if current != EXPECTED:
        require(RECEIPT.is_file() and not RECEIPT.is_symlink(), 'deployment receipt unavailable; refuse unknown rollback')
        receipt = json.loads(RECEIPT.read_text())
        require(receipt.get('run_id') == os.environ.get('SSM_ReleaseRunId'), 'stale recovery request; refuse newer deployment rollback')
        require(current == receipt['candidate_sha256'], 'current JAR belongs to another release; refuse overwrite')
        # Reuse verified atomic restore, but this UI-only path never edits environment files.
        atomic_restore(BACKUP/'app.jar', JAR, data['jar_metadata'])
    command('systemctl', 'restart', 'f2r-app.service')
    health()
    require(digest(JAR)['sha256'] == EXPECTED, 'rollback JAR mismatch')
    media_unchanged(data); environment_unchanged(data)
    print(json.dumps({'result': 'ROLLBACK_VERIFIED', 'jar_sha256': EXPECTED, 'media_unchanged': True}))

def verify_restore():
    data=check_backup()
    require(os.geteuid()==0,'root execution required')
    for p in [JAR]+ENV_FILES:
        require(not p.is_symlink(),'restore target symlink rejected')
        require(p.parent.resolve()==p.parent,'restore parent symlink rejected')
        require(os.access(p.parent,os.W_OK),'restore target parent not writable')
    require(command('systemctl','show','f2r-app.service','-p','LoadState','--value')=='loaded','application unit unavailable')
    return data
def verify_permission():
    data = verify_restore()
    media_unchanged(data)
    environment_unchanged(data)
    ready_to_restart()
    print(json.dumps({'result': 'RESTORE_PREFLIGHT_OK', 'restart_executed': False,
                      'note': 'SSM restore document executed as root; full recovery drill not performed'}))

try:
    os.umask(0o077)
    require(os.geteuid()==0, 'SSM root required')
    with open('/var/lock/f2r-pr914-release.lock','a') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        operation = os.environ.get('SSM_Operation', '')
        require(operation in ('verify','restore'), 'unsupported operation or outdated SSM agent')
        (verify_permission if operation == 'verify' else rollback)()
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({'result':'FAIL','reason':str(e) if isinstance(e,RuntimeError) else type(e).__name__}))
    sys.exit(1)
